title: Nine Rounds of Bell
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：boxing　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 boxing 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was sent to judge ① a boxing match she could not watch, and she said the watching was the whole of the lesson. The ② boxing, meaning the sport and not the match, was nine rounds long and was scored by whoever came last; boxing, she said, is the only thing in a gym that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ boxing class in that gym had the same bell, and the ④ boxing at the end, meaning the one the trainer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever scored properly. Boxing, my grandmother said, is nine parts nerve and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the nerve is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ boxing was the whole of the winter, meaning the season it filled and not the sport. The ⑥ boxing, meaning the winter and not any of that, is the only thing in a town that everybody watches and nobody questions; boxing, he said, is either something you judge or the only word that means both a sport and a winter. She said the winter is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ boxing had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the bell. The ⑧ boxing of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine rounds and eleven years of judging; boxing, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ boxing I remember is the one at the end, which was filmed in 1975 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ boxing match, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being watched; every boxing, she said, is a winter that has agreed to look like a sport. She said the winter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 拳击（指这项运动本身，与那场比赛相对）
C. 固定搭配：judge a boxing match 为一场拳击比赛评分
D. n. 拳击（指那家拳馆的每一节课）
E. n. 拳击（指末尾那一场）
F. n. 拳击（抽象：它所填满的那个冬天）
G. n. 那个冬天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a boxing match she could not watch
The boxing, meaning the sport and not the match
Every boxing class in that gym
boxing was the whole of the winter
the boxing had become a photograph in a report
The boxing of the whole thing
A boxing match, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: judge a boxing match 意为“为一场拳击比赛评分”，1953 年母亲被派去评一场她看不下去的比赛。
boxing 意为“拳击”，指这项运动本身而不是那场比赛，共九个回合，由最后来的人打分。
boxing 指那家拳馆的每一节拳击课，每一节都是同一个铃。
boxing 指末尾那一场（教练留的那一场），是唯一有人认真打过分的。
boxing 意为“拳击”，抽象指它所填满的那个冬天，父亲说 boxing 就是那个冬天的全部。
boxing 为抽象用法，指那个冬天本身，是镇上人人都看、却没人质疑的东西。
boxing 意为“拳击运动”，到 1970 年这项 boxing 成了报告里的一张照片。
boxing 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个回合和十一年的评分。
boxing 意为“拳击”，我记得的是末尾那一场，1975 年被拍下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
boxing 为抽象总称，祖母说拳击比赛是唯一会因为有人认真看而变好的东西。
